decision_author: release coordinator, after two separately recorded independent agent reviews
limitations: This is a separate explicit resource decision under the original registered review policy. The original automatic accepted:false verdict and failed workflow conclusion are retained, not converted into an automatic pass.
Import timing does not execute the C7 MCP stdout adapter or token_budget module. Its cost cannot be attributed to that transport change; compilation is not a quantitatively isolated cause.
Both labeled native-open measurements create fresh empty databases before ingestion. The public label is not evidence that a larger corpus caused the increase.

The public candidate 39.683334 ms opening sample is retained without claiming a proven I/O or scheduler cause. The synthetic baseline 946.793415 ms opening sample is retained and its apparent mean improvement is not used as a benefit or offset.

Startup intervals overlap and must not be added. Short-lived processes or workloads repeatedly creating archives may care more about startup costs. Four rounds do not establish worst-case bounds or universal performance superiority.
No new timing was performed for this decision. The source/evaluator/thresholds are frozen; earlier C3/C5/C6 failures and C7 development limitations remain available.
Historical competitor outputs remain compatible, but competitor timings were not rerun for C7. This decision does not establish that AI Memory Book wins every metric or every repository comparison.
original_resource_rule: Any increase above 10% requires an explicit cause and independent review; no automatic override.
rationale: All unchanged numerical recall gates pass: pooled p95 geometric mean improves 14.797575645674566%, best public native token p95 improves 15.740556756207392%, and real public MCP token1024 p95 improves 12.173437630095552%. No pooled p50/p95 regression exceeds 5%; every pooled mean/p50/p95 improves.

All 56,784 calls, 28,392 complete paired outputs and original invariants pass independent saved-data audit. A separate 2,304-call Hotpot256 comparison reproduces the historical complete default outputs.

The three reviewed resource increases are one-time import and fresh-empty-database construction costs, with mean absolute increases 3.197244 ms, 2.99035475 ms, and 5.1004795 ms. Two independent reviews accept this disclosed startup tradeoff for the measured persistent-service use.

Added Python source compilation/definitions/initialization and added empty-database schema/index/pager setup are code-supported cost sources. Exact quantitative subphase attribution was not measured and is not claimed.

The other 25 registered resource means remain below the unchanged 10% review trigger; actual SDK startup mean changes range from -0.28667612309926094% to +1.579351094597059%. Original resource samples, including adverse outliers, remain unchanged.
